diseases.name: Rotator cuff tendinopathy / impingement
diseases.inv: Clinical; ultrasound or MRI if persistent.
diseases.alt: Frozen shoulder, cervical radiculopathy, referred pain

diseases.name: Frozen shoulder (adhesive capsulitis)
diseases.inv: Clinical; X-ray; check glucose.
diseases.alt: Rotator cuff tear, OA, referred pain

diseases.name: Shoulder dislocation
diseases.inv: X-ray; check axillary nerve and pulses; reduction by trained clinician.

diseases.name: Referred cardiac pain
diseases.inv: ECG and troponin if exertional features.

diseases.name: Meniscal tear
diseases.inv: Clinical; MRI.

diseases.name: Ligament injury (e.g. ACL tear)
diseases.inv: X-ray to exclude fracture; MRI.

diseases.name: Patellofemoral pain syndrome
diseases.inv: Clinical.

diseases.name: Hip osteoarthritis
diseases.inv: X-ray pelvis and hip.
diseases.alt: Avascular necrosis, referred spine pain, bursitis

diseases.name: Hip fracture
diseases.inv: X-ray pelvis; urgent orthopaedic care; analgesia.

diseases.name: Avascular necrosis of femoral head
diseases.inv: MRI hip.

diseases.name: Greater trochanteric pain syndrome
diseases.inv: Clinical.

diseases.name: Transient synovitis of the hip
diseases.inv: Clinical; ultrasound; exclude septic arthritis.

diseases.name: Perthes disease
diseases.inv: X-ray hip; paediatric orthopaedics.

diseases.name: Slipped capital femoral epiphysis
diseases.inv: X-ray both hips (AP and lateral); urgent orthopaedic review; avoid weight bearing.

diseases.name: Paediatric septic arthritis / osteomyelitis
diseases.inv: Urgent CBC, CRP, blood cultures, ultrasound; senior orthopaedic review.

diseases.name: Fracture
diseases.inv: X-ray two views including joints above and below.
diseases.alt: Soft tissue injury, dislocation, pathological fracture

diseases.name: Neurovascular compromise with injury
diseases.inv: Urgent vascular and orthopaedic review; do not delay.

diseases.name: Open fracture
diseases.inv: Cover wound, splint, tetanus, antibiotics per protocol, urgent surgery.

diseases.name: Compartment syndrome
diseases.inv: Emergency senior surgical review; clinical diagnosis; do not wait for tests.

diseases.name: Cervical radiculopathy
diseases.inv: Clinical; MRI if persistent or neurological deficit.

diseases.name: Cervical myelopathy
diseases.inv: Urgent MRI cervical spine; surgical opinion.

diseases.name: Whiplash / cervical sprain
diseases.inv: Clinical; imaging if red flags or neurological signs.

diseases.name: Carpal tunnel syndrome
diseases.inv: Clinical; nerve conduction study; check TSH and glucose.
diseases.alt: Cervical radiculopathy, ulnar neuropathy, peripheral neuropathy

diseases.name: Ulnar neuropathy (cubital tunnel)
diseases.inv: Clinical; nerve conduction study.

diseases.name: Scaphoid fracture
diseases.inv: X-ray wrist with scaphoid views; repeat or MRI if normal but suspicious.
diseases.alt: Wrist sprain, De Quervain, radius fracture

diseases.name: De Quervain tenosynovitis
diseases.inv: Clinical (Finkelstein test).

diseases.name: Statin-related myopathy
diseases.inv: CK, TSH, review the statin.

diseases.name: Polymyalgia rheumatica
diseases.inv: ESR/CRP; consider giant cell arteritis.

diseases.name: Lymphatic filariasis / chronic lymphoedema
diseases.inv: Clinical; night blood smear or antigen test.
diseases.alt: DVT, heart failure, venous disease, cellulitis

diseases.name: Osteomyelitis
diseases.inv: CBC, CRP, blood culture, X-ray, MRI.

diseases.name: Rickets
diseases.inv: X-ray wrist, vitamin D, calcium, phosphate, ALP.

diseases.name: Mechanical fall
diseases.inv: Falls assessment, vision, footwear, home hazards.

diseases.name: Fall with medical cause (syncope, drugs, hypotension)
diseases.inv: ECG, orthostatic BP, glucose, medicines review.

flags.text: Severe pain with tense swelling and pain on stretch: possible compartment syndrome, emergency
Injured limb that is pale, cold or numb: limb-threatening, urgent
Open fracture: urgent surgery, cover wound, tetanus and antibiotics
Neck pain with clumsy hands, unsteady walking or bladder trouble: possible myelopathy, urgent
Fall with shortened turned-out leg: possible hip fracture
Child with fever who refuses to bear weight: possible septic arthritis/osteomyelitis, urgent
Overweight adolescent with hip or knee pain and limp: possible SCFE, avoid weight bearing, urgent
